title_en: Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship Selection (Apply by December 8)
summary: Undergraduate students selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program (through the Office of International Affairs or the college's own program) who meet the income-bracket and grade requirements may apply for the Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship. Applications must be submitted online through MySNU between 1 December 2026 and 18:00 on 8 December 2026. Selected students must submit their Spring 2027 transcript and a post-scholarship report to the department office by email by 30 July 2027.
applies_to: Optional application for undergraduate students who meet all of the following: (1) their student financial aid income bracket (학자금 지원구간) for Fall 2026 is bracket 8 or below; (2) their grade average for the immediately preceding semester is 2.4 or above; and (3) they have been selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program dispatched by the Office of International Affairs (국제처) or by the college itself. Any income bracket calculated by the Korea Student Aid Foundation (for the National Scholarship, student loans, National Work Scholarship, etc.) is accepted. Only students who have entered their overseas study information and whose overseas study plan has been approved can apply on MySNU. Selected students must submit a transcript and post-scholarship report.

translation:
Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship Selection Plan (Apply by Tuesday, 8 December)

The selection plan for the Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) Overseas Study Scholarship (해외수학장학생) is announced as follows.

A. Number of recipients: approximately 30 (may change depending on the budget situation)

B. Eligibility: Undergraduate students whose student financial aid income bracket* (학자금 지원구간) for Fall 2026 is bracket 8 or below (with a grade average of 2.4 or above in the immediately preceding semester) and who have been selected for a Spring 2027 exchange student program dispatched by the Office of International Affairs (국제처) or by the college itself.
* All student financial aid income brackets calculated by the Korea Student Aid Foundation, such as for the National Scholarship, student loans and the National Work Scholarship, are accepted.

C. Application period: Tuesday, 1 December 2026 – Tuesday, 8 December 2026, 18:00

D. How to apply: Apply online through MySNU (마이스누). (The Scholarship and Welfare Division (장학복지과) plans to process approvals in a batch.)

E. Notes
1) Only students who have entered their overseas study information and whose overseas study plan has been approved can apply on MySNU.
2) Scholarship recipients must comply with the obligation to submit a "transcript and post-scholarship report" (성적표 및 수혜 후기 보고서). Submit the Spring 2027 transcript and post-scholarship report to the department office by email by Friday, 30 July 2027. (The email address is given in the original notice.)

Attachments
1. Spring 2027 Overseas Study Scholarship application guide, 1 copy.
2. Spring 2027 scholarship post-scholarship report and pledge (서약서) (for selected students), 1 copy each.

Attached files (2):
- 2027학년도 1학기 해외수학장학생 신청안내.hwp (71 KB)
- 선발자 제출서류(서약서 및 수혜 후기 보고서).hwp (49 KB)

(The contents of the attached files were not included in the notice text and have not been read.)
